title: Handling a Cancelled International Flight
paragraphs: Arriving at the airport for an important international connection, Bram discovered his flight had been cancelled entirely due to unforeseen technical issues, leaving him stranded with no immediately obvious alternative to reach his destination in time.

Rather than joining the long, frustrated line at the airline counter, Bram simultaneously called the airline's phone support and searched for alternative routes himself, ultimately securing a rebooking through a different connecting city.

This solution required an unplanned overnight layover, considerably more time and expense than his original itinerary, yet remained preferable to the alternative of missing his destination commitment entirely.

Reflecting on the disruption, Bram noted that maintaining calm, methodical problem-solving under pressure, rather than joining the frustrated crowd, made the eventual resolution considerably faster than passive waiting would likely have achieved.
